original_description: AI report-writing assistant for Charleston DPS officers. Draft narratives, review reports, check Missouri and local charges, build probable cause statements, prepare prosecutor materials, and audit cases for missing or suppression-sensitive details..

limitations: 説明はミズーリ州と現地の罪名確認を対象とする。対象組織との関係や法的な正確性は未確認。
